explanation: Evidence supports bioavailability, half-life, accumulation, steady-state timing, and hepatic dose reduction. But claims about capsule-must-be-with-food vs tablet-food-optional, and metabolism via CYP3A/SULT2A1 with weak time-dependent CYP3A inhibition, are not supported by any evidence shown.
suggested_rewrite: Remove or separately cite the formulation-food requirements and CYP3A/SULT2A1 metabolism/inhibition claims until supporting label evidence is provided; retain only PK and hepatic-dose statements backed by cited evidence.
